name: keepdeck-session-reporter
description: Reports Kimi Code session identity and turn lifecycle to the KeepDeck pane that launched it.
author: KeepDeck

interface.shortDescription: Keeps Kimi Code sessions attached to their KeepDeck panes.
interface.longDescription: Reports SessionStart identity and turn-lifecycle events (turn start/end, waiting on approval, interrupt, failure) only when Kimi Code was launched by KeepDeck. It is inert in every other Kimi session.
